features.statement: Page is styled by a single inline style block with no external stylesheets or scripts.
Page title repeats the H1 wording, prefixed with the brand name.
H1 is large (about 3× body size) and bold; H2s are bold at about 1.7× body, on a rem-multiple type scale.
Heading hierarchy is irregular: levels skip (H1 to H4 for feature cards) and footer column titles are H2s.
Repeated listing cards are article elements, each titled with an H3 domain name shown capitalized.
Uses semantic landmarks: header, nav, main, footer, sections and articles.
Metric values and labels use b and small elements, forming repeated three-stat tiles per card.
Layout relies more on CSS grid than flexbox, within a centered container of roughly 1070px.
Header is a white bar with logo at left and nav links plus a bordered language box at right.
Hero is a full-width diagonal blue gradient, the only gradient on the page.
Hero contains a centered search form: white rounded container holding an input and a blue button.
Translucent white chips sit beneath the hero search form.
Corners are moderately rounded (8–15px) with no true pill radii; most elements are square.
Cards are white with hairline light-grey borders and moderate rounding, with almost no shadows; borders do the separating.
Body text is muted gray-blue while titles are dark slate, giving a cool neutral text palette.
Palette is blue on cool neutrals; green, orange and red appear only as status colors.
Metric values are colored by threshold: green high, orange mid, red low, dark neutral.
A single blue accent is reused for links, logo and icons.
Section header rows pair a heading at left with a blue text link with arrow at right.
Stat labels are small uppercase text with letter spacing.
Every image has descriptive alt text following a consistent 'Screenshot of <domain>' pattern.
Card thumbnails are third-party screenshots sitting flush at the top of cards, clipped by rounded corners.
Icons are a few small inline SVG line icons; arrows are text glyphs.
Footer is dark with light slate text.
Text sections like About sit on a white full-width band with paragraphs narrower than the container.
Vertical spacing between sections is generous, with large gaps before section headings.
Copy is short and plain, with no emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes.
Motion is limited to simple transitions, with no animations, transforms or backdrop blur.
Meta tags are minimal: charset, viewport and description only.
Few hand-written class names rather than utility-framework classes.
Listings show placeholder-like zero values for some metrics.
